structured_output.summary: The change implements DisposableStack.prototype.defer in the single in-scope file, following the six spec steps in order. Step 2 uses require_disposable_stack (RequireInternalSlot) with `?`. Step 3 throws a ReferenceError when the stack is disposed. Step 4 uses ops::is_callable and throws a TypeError. Step 5 calls add_disposable_resource with undefined as value, Sync kind and the callable as method, with `?`. Step 6 returns undefined. Each step keeps its spec comment above its code. The `new_target` parameter is renamed to `_new_target`, which is harmless. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, no fabricated return values, and no unrelated files changed. The helpers (require_disposable_stack, add_disposable_resource, disposable_stack) already exist in the support module and are not added by this diff, so their correctness is outside this review. The gate report shows build and clippy OK, 14 new passing tests and 0 regressions.
